achievements.name: Awaken Pyra
achievements.detail: Resonate with Pyra so Rex fights beside her as her Driver.

achievements.name: Argentum
achievements.detail: Complete the opening voyage and step into the Argentum Trade Guild.

achievements.name: Gormott
achievements.detail: Leave Argentum behind and set foot on the titan Gormott.

achievements.name: Driver Combo
achievements.detail: Chain Break, Topple, Launch, and Smash on one enemy.

achievements.name: Blade Combo
achievements.detail: Finish a Blade Combo by landing three Specials in the elemental order shown.

achievements.name: Chain Attack
achievements.detail: Fill the Party Gauge and unleash a Chain Attack in battle.

achievements.name: Rare Blade
achievements.detail: Awaken a Rare Blade from a Core Crystal.

achievements.name: Affinity Chart
achievements.detail: Unlock a node on a Blade's Affinity Chart by fulfilling what that node asks.

achievements.name: Merc Mission
achievements.detail: Dispatch Blades on a Merc Mission and collect the reward when they report back.

achievements.name: Tiger! Tiger!
achievements.detail: Clear a stage of the Tiger! Tiger! game that upgrades Poppi.

achievements.name: Unique Monster
achievements.detail: Find a Unique Monster in the field and defeat it.

achievements.name: Journey's End
achievements.detail: Win the story's last battle and watch the ending through.
